# pritunl_host (Resource)

The host resource manages the settings of a Pritunl host. Hosts are born when the pritunl agent registers, never created by Terraform: this resource adopts the instance's single host and manages its settings (the display name and the public address clients connect to). An instance running more than one host is not supported and fails naming them. Destroying the resource only forgets it — the host itself is never removed.

An unset attribute keeps the value the host already carries: the public address stays auto-detected until it is configured, and configuring it is what pins the address clients connect to (the console's "Public Address" host setting).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "pritunl_host" "gate" {
  public_address = "gate.qa.example.com"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `name` (String) The host's display name. Unset keeps the name the host already carries.
- `public_address` (String) The public address clients connect to. Unset keeps the address the host already carries (auto-detected when never configured).

### Read-Only

- `hostname` (String) The machine hostname the adopted host registered with.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
